k:酸.mnemonic: A wine jar (酉) left open too long. A cocoon (厶) that fell in grows legs (儿) and has to trudge (夂) out, because the wine has turned sharp enough to sting. Acid (bitterness, sour, tart).
k:酸.hint: Cocoon crawling out of sour wine.

k:附.mnemonic: A notice you attach (付) to a post on top of the mound (阝) so the whole village can read it. Once nailed on, it stays put. Affixed (attach, refer to, append).
k:附.hint: Notice nailed up on the mound.

k:旗.mnemonic: The sweet (甘) shop flies a long cloth that streams in the direction (方) of the wind, so children can find it from anywhere in town. Banner (flag, standard).
k:旗.hint: Cloth streaming over the sweet shop.

k:歯.mnemonic: An open jaw drawn as a box, packed with little grains of teeth, and above it the gums gripping them like a foot planted firm. A mouth seen from the front. Tooth (cog).

k:露.mnemonic: The rain (雨) that settles without a sound overnight. You set out at dawn under a clear sky and the whole route (路) is beaded with drops that wet your ankles. Dew (tears, expose, Russia).
k:露.hint: Wet path on a clear morning.

k:俺.mnemonic: A leader (亻) so full of himself that he will smother (奄) every conversation with a single topic: me, me, me. Myself (I).
k:俺.hint: Leader who talks of one person.

k:緑.mnemonic: A servant (隶) dyes thread (糸) all day in a vat of crushed leaves, and goes home with hands the colour of grass. Green.
k:緑.hint: Servant's hands stained by leaf dye.

k:唯.mnemonic: A turkey (隹) whose mouth (口) makes one noise and one noise only: gobble. Ask it anything you like, that is the whole answer. Solely (only, merely, simply).

k:範.mnemonic: The car (車) maker keeps a bamboo (竹) template. Each fishhook (乙) shaped part is bent to match it, then gets a stamp (卩) of approval, so every car comes out the same. Pattern (example, model).

k:壁.mnemonic: Where you reside (居), the cook next door fries spicy (辛) peppers all day. You pile up soil (土) between the two houses until the fumes cannot get through. Wall (lining, fence).
k:壁.hint: Soil piled against the spicy fumes.

k:柳.mnemonic: A tree (木) by the river whose trailing branches dip in the water and stamp (卩) wet lines on the bank each time the wind swings them. Willow.

k:駐.mnemonic: The master (主) ties his horse (馬) to the rail outside the inn for the night. He will ride on tomorrow. Stop-over (reside in, resident).

k:霊.mnemonic: In the rain (雨) at night, three (三) pale shapes drift above the ground and the drops fall straight through them. Spirits (soul).
k:霊.hint: Three pale shapes in the rain.

k:侵.mnemonic: A leader (亻) with lowered forehead (冖) pushes his broom (ヨ) across the boundary line, sweeping his own yard and also (又) a strip of yours, a little further each day. Encroach (invade, raid, trespass).

k:誕.mnemonic: A messenger on a long stride (廴) will not stop (止) until he can say (言) the news at every door in the village: a child has arrived. Nativity (be born).

k:堀.mnemonic: Plant a flag (尸) where the digging starts. The soil (土) must exit (出) the trench by the bucketful until water can run all the way round the castle. Ditch (moat, canal).
k:堀.hint: Soil carried out of the trench.

k:撲.mnemonic: A person (人) reaches out to touch the beauty (美) in the painting, and the guard's fingers (扌) come down smartly on the back of his hand. Slap (strike, hit, beat).
k:撲.hint: Guard's fingers smack a reaching hand.

k:撤.mnemonic: The camp where they bring up (育) the cadets is closing. Fingers (扌) pull out the pegs and they strike (攵) the tents, and by noon the field is bare. Remove (withdraw, disarm, dismantle).
k:撤.hint: Pulling pegs, taking down the tents.

k:繰.mnemonic: Spools of goods (品) sit on top of a tree (木), and thread (糸) is reeled onto them, round and round, from the silkworms in the branches. Winding (reel, spin, look up).
k:繰.hint: Spools in a tree reeling silk.

k:菊.mnemonic: Flowers (艹) whose petals are as thin and as many as grains of rice (米), all curling inward as if held in a cradle (勹). Chrysanthemum.

k:塩.mnemonic: The plain dish (皿) of soup tastes of nothing until one white pinch goes in. Then the flavour is a revelation (告). Salt.

k:尊.mnemonic: The oldest wine jar (酉) in the cellar is poured by exact measurement (寸), a thimble at a time, and only for the most honoured guest. Revered (valuable, precious, noble).
k:尊.hint: Oldest jar poured by the thimble.

k:怒.mnemonic: That guy (奴) again. Just seeing him walk in makes your heart (心) pound and your face go red. Angry (be offended).
k:怒.hint: That guy makes your heart pound.

k:叫.mnemonic: Stand in the middle (中) of the square and be as loud as ten (十) people, so that every corner can hear you. Shout (exclaim, yell).
k:叫.hint: Loud as ten in the square.

k:阜.mnemonic: A mound (阝) just tall enough that if you climb it and shout (叫), the whole village hears you. Not a mountain, only a small rise. Hillock (mound, hill).
k:阜.hint: Small rise you call out from.

k:欲.mnemonic: You lack (欠) the one thing you want, and the gap it leaves inside feels as wide and empty as a valley (谷). Longing (covetousness, greed, passion).

k:畑.mnemonic: Not a wet rice field (田) but a dry one cleared by fire (火): burn off the brush, then plant vegetables in the ash. Farm (field, garden, one's specialty).

k:豪.mnemonic: A giant boar. The pig (豕) lowers its bristling forehead (冖), opens its mouth (口) in a roar and charges, and nothing in its way can hold it back. Overpowering (great, powerful, excelling).
